messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: prod us-west-2: streaming responses p95 latency spike (>800ms), GPU queue depth high. Pager sent to oncall.
Maya (oncall): Acknowledged. Paging Ravi (SRE). Oncall triage — initial guess: many long-lived SSE connections saturating mux workers.
Ravi (sre): Looking at metrics now. Active SSE connections concentrated to a handful of tenants. mux-prod CPU 92%, worker queue length growing, push frames backlog.
Priya (platform): If SSEs are the hotspot we can flip streaming to polling fallback globally or per-tenant. Quick global toggle reduces per-connection overhead.
Maya (oncall): Agree. Plan: (1) disable streaming responses globally (fallback to polling), (2) tighten per-route rate limits, (3) drain existing SSE conns gracefully. Jordan, prep customer comms/status.
Ravi (sre): Commands ready — executing feature toggle now:
```
curl -XPOST 'https://admin.redwood.ai/api/v1/feature-toggle' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"feature":"streaming_responses","value":false,"scope":"global"}'
```
DeployBot: Feature flag update queued on control-plane; propagation ETA ~30s.
Ravi (sre): Also applying temporary rate/conn limits for /v1/stream route:
```
infractl ratelimit set --route /v1/stream --window 1s --limit 10
infractl connlimit set --route /v1/stream --max-conns 50
```
Jordan (support): Crafting notices to top customers and updating status page. Draft: "Temporarily disabling streaming responses to stabilize latency; poll endpoints and short-poll SDK will continue to work."
Priya (platform): Rolling toggle now — Ravi please confirm when metrics trend down.
DeployBot: Flag set: streaming_responses=false (propagated).
Ravi (sre): Control-plane shows flag. Draining active SSE connections (grace=30s):
```
curl -XPOST 'https://control.redwood.ai/api/v1/mux/drain?grace=30'
```
Maya (oncall): Monitoring p95 latency and mux queue depth.
Ravi (sre): 2m after toggle: mux CPU down to ~60%, SSE conn count 18k -> 800, text gen p95 220ms -> 140ms. Looks stable.
Jordan (support): Customer notices sent + status updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1719001234
Priya (platform): Follow-ups: investigate backpressure path on mux, implement per-tenant streaming quotas, add automatic client fallback when per-tenant SSE > threshold.
Maya (oncall): Handing off to SRE for post-incident. If regression, page me. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (sre): Will open a follow-up incident doc and link metrics + heap dumps. ty
Jordan (support): Closing initial page, monitoring for reappears. :thumbsup:
